1. import { Application, Context } from 'probot' // eslint-disable-line no-unused-vars
2. import {
3.   PullRequestsCreateReviewParams, IssuesAddLabelsParams, PullRequestsListReviewsParams, PullRequestsListReviewsResponse
4. } from '@octokit/rest'
5. 
6. const getConfig = require('probot-config')
7. 
8. export = (app: Application) => {
9.   app.on(['pull_request.opened', 'pull_request.reopened', 'pull_request.labeled', 'pull_request.edited', 'pull_request_review'], async (context) => {
10.     // reading configuration
11.     const config = await getConfig(context, 'autoapproval.yml')
12.     context.log(config, '\n\nLoaded config')
13.     context.log('Repo: %s', context.payload.repository.full_name)
14. 
15.     const pr = context.payload.pull_request
16.     context.log('PR: %s', pr.html_url)
17.     const prLabels: string[] = pr.labels.map((label: any) => label.name)
18. 
19.     // determine if the PR has any "blacklisted" labels
20.     var blacklistedLabels: string[] = []
21.     if (config.blacklisted_labels) {
22.       blacklistedLabels = config.blacklisted_labels
23.         .filter((blacklistedLabel: any) => prLabels.includes(blacklistedLabel))
24. 
25.       // if PR contains any black listed labels, do not proceed further
26.       if (blacklistedLabels.length > 0) {
27.         context.log('PR black listed from approving: %s', blacklistedLabels)
28.         return
29.       }
30.     }
31. 
32.     // reading pull request owner info and check it with configuration
33.     const ownerSatisfied = config.from_owner.length === 0 || config.from_owner.includes(pr.user.login)
34. 
35.     // reading pull request labels and check them with configuration
36.     let requiredLabelsSatisfied
37.     if (config.required_labels_mode == "one_of") {
38.       // one of the required_labels needs to be applied
39.       const appliedRequiredLabels = config.required_labels
40.         .filter((requiredLabel: any) => prLabels.includes(requiredLabel))
41.       requiredLabelsSatisfied = appliedRequiredLabels.length > 0
42. 
43.     } else {
44.       // all of the required_labels need to be applied
45.       const missingRequiredLabels = config.required_labels
46.         .filter((requiredLabel: any) => !prLabels.includes(requiredLabel))
47.       requiredLabelsSatisfied = missingRequiredLabels.length === 0
48.     }
49. 
50.     if (requiredLabelsSatisfied && ownerSatisfied) {
51.       const reviews = await getAutoapprovalReviews(context)
52. 
53.       if (reviews.length > 0) {
54.         context.log('PR has already reviews')
55.         if (context.payload.action === 'dismissed') {
56.           approvePullRequest(context)
57.           applyLabels(context, config.apply_labels as string[])
58.           context.log('Review was dismissed, approve again')
59.         }
60.       } else {
61.         approvePullRequest(context)
62.         applyLabels(context, config.apply_labels as string[])
63.         context.log('PR approved first time')
64.       }
65.     } else {
66.       // one of the checks failed
67.       context.log('Condition failed! \n - missing required labels: %s\n - PR owner found: %s', requiredLabelsSatisfied, ownerSatisfied)
68.     }
69.   })
70. }
71. 
72. async function approvePullRequest (context: Context) {
73.   const prParams = context.issue({ event: 'APPROVE', body: 'Approved :+1:' })
74.   await context.github.pullRequests.createReview(prParams as PullRequestsCreateReviewParams)
75. }
76. 
77. async function applyLabels (context: Context, labels: string[]) {
78.   // if there are labels required to be added, add them
79.   if (labels.length > 0) {
80.     // trying to apply existing labels to PR. If labels didn't exist, this call will fail
81.     const labelsParam = context.issue({ labels: labels })
82.     await context.github.issues.addLabels(labelsParam as IssuesAddLabelsParams)
83.   }
84. }
85. 
86. async function getAutoapprovalReviews (context: Context): Promise<PullRequestsListReviewsResponse> {
87.   const reviewParams = context.issue()
88.   const reviews = await context.github.pullRequests.listReviews(reviewParams as PullRequestsListReviewsParams)
89. 
90.   const autoapprovalReviews = (reviews.data as PullRequestsListReviewsResponse)
91.     .filter(item => item.user.login === 'autoapproval[bot]')
92. 
93.   return autoapprovalReviews
94. }

4. } from '@octokit/rest'
5. 
6. const getConfig = require('probot-config')
7. 
8. export = (app: Application) => {
9.   app.on(['pull_request.opened', 'pull_request.reopened', 'pull_request.labeled', 'pull_request.edited', 'pull_request_review'], async (context) => {
10.     // reading configuration
11.     const config = await getConfig(context, 'autoapproval.yml')
12.     context.log(config, '\n\nLoaded config')
13.     context.log('Repo: %s', context.payload.repository.full_name)
14.

16.     context.log('PR: %s', pr.html_url)
17.     const prLabels: string[] = pr.labels.map((label: any) => label.name)
18. 
19.     // determine if the PR has any "blacklisted" labels
20.     var blacklistedLabels: string[] = []
21.     if (config.blacklisted_labels) {
22.       blacklistedLabels = config.blacklisted_labels
23.         .filter((blacklistedLabel: any) => prLabels.includes(blacklistedLabel))
24. 
25.       // if PR contains any black listed labels, do not proceed further
26.       if (blacklistedLabels.length > 0) {
27.         context.log('PR black listed from approving: %s', blacklistedLabels)
28.         return
29.       }
30.     }
31.

33.     const ownerSatisfied = config.from_owner.length === 0 || config.from_owner.includes(pr.user.login)
34. 
35.     // reading pull request labels and check them with configuration
36.     let requiredLabelsSatisfied
37.     if (config.required_labels_mode == "one_of") {
38.       // one of the required_labels needs to be applied
39.       const appliedRequiredLabels = config.required_labels
40.         .filter((requiredLabel: any) => prLabels.includes(requiredLabel))
41.       requiredLabelsSatisfied = appliedRequiredLabels.length > 0
42. 
43.     } else {
44.       // all of the required_labels need to be applied
45.       const missingRequiredLabels = config.required_labels
46.         .filter((requiredLabel: any) => !prLabels.includes(requiredLabel))
47.       requiredLabelsSatisfied = missingRequiredLabels.length === 0
48.     }
49. 
50.     if (requiredLabelsSatisfied && ownerSatisfied) {
51.       const reviews = await getAutoapprovalReviews(context)
52. 
53.       if (reviews.length > 0) {
54.         context.log('PR has already reviews')
55.         if (context.payload.action === 'dismissed') {
56.           approvePullRequest(context)
57.           applyLabels(context, config.apply_labels as string[])
58.           context.log('Review was dismissed, approve again')
59.         }
60.       } else {
61.         approvePullRequest(context)
62.         applyLabels(context, config.apply_labels as string[])
63.         context.log('PR approved first time')
64.       }
65.     } else {
66.       // one of the checks failed
67.       context.log('Condition failed! \n - missing required labels: %s\n - PR owner found: %s', requiredLabelsSatisfied, ownerSatisfied)
68.     }
69.   })
70. }

72. async function approvePullRequest (context: Context) {
73.   const prParams = context.issue({ event: 'APPROVE', body: 'Approved :+1:' })
74.   await context.github.pullRequests.createReview(prParams as PullRequestsCreateReviewParams)
75. }
76. 
77. async function applyLabels (context: Context, labels: string[]) {
78.   // if there are labels required to be added, add them
79.   if (labels.length > 0) {
80.     // trying to apply existing labels to PR. If labels didn't exist, this call will fail
81.     const labelsParam = context.issue({ labels: labels })
82.     await context.github.issues.addLabels(labelsParam as IssuesAddLabelsParams)
83.   }
84. }
85. 
86. async function getAutoapprovalReviews (context: Context): Promise<PullRequestsListReviewsResponse> {
87.   const reviewParams = context.issue()
88.   const reviews = await context.github.pullRequests.listReviews(reviewParams as PullRequestsListReviewsParams)
89. 
90.   const autoapprovalReviews = (reviews.data as PullRequestsListReviewsResponse)
91.     .filter(item => item.user.login === 'autoapproval[bot]')
92. 
93.   return autoapprovalReviews
94. }

# autoapproval

[![Build Status](https://travis-ci.org/dkhmelenko/autoapproval.svg?branch=master)](https://travis-ci.org/dkhmelenko/autoapproval)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/dkhmelenko/autoapproval/branch/master/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/dkhmelenko/autoapproval)

A GitHub App built with [Probot](https://github.com/probot/probot) for approving pull requests automatically

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4306809/50573484-13a0a100-0dd5-11e9-8ef3-aad5069e83e3.png)

## Setup

```sh
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Run typescript
npm run build

# Run the bot
npm start
```

This app requires `Write code` permissions in order not to have issues with approving PRs.
```
Repository administrators can require that all pull requests receive a specific number of approving reviews from people with write or admin permissions in the repository or from a designated code owner before they're merged into a protected branch.

...

You won't be able to merge your pull request until the required number of reviewers with write or admin permissions in the repository approve your pull request's changes in their review.
```

More about it can be found on [Github Help](https://help.github.com/en/articles/about-pull-request-reviews#required-reviews).

## Configuration

In order to use the bot, the config file should be provided. Config file should be defined in your repository. Config file is the yml file with the path `.github/autoapproval.yml`. The file should have 3 entries.

### from_owner
Defines the list of users, whos pull requests should be approved automatically. For example:
```
from_owner:
  - dkhmelenko
  - quongeri
```
Assign an empty array if you want to approve PRs from any user (example: `from_owner: []`).

### required_labels
Defines the list of labels on PR, which should be present for approving PR automatically. For example:
```
required_labels:
  - ready
```
Assign an empty array if you want to approve PRs without any label (example: `required_labels: []`).

### blacklisted_labels
Defines the list of labels on PR, which will prevent the PR from being automatically approved. For example:
```
blacklisted_labels:
  - wip
```
Assign an empty array if you do not want to blacklist any labels.

### apply_labels
Defines the list of labels on PR, which should be added once PR was approved automatically. For example:
```
apply_labels:
  - merge
```
Assign an empty array if no labels should be applied to PRs (example: `apply_labels: []`).

_NOTES_: 
1. If label doesn't exist, it will not be created. In order to apply the label after approving PR automatically, you need to define the label beforehand.
2. If PR already contains a review from this bot, new approval will not happen. Except the case when review was dismissed.

### required_labels_mode
Defines the behavior how `required_labels` should be treated.
If nothing specified, then all labels from `required_label` are mandatory.
If the value set to `one_of`, then it's enough to have only of the `required_labels` to get approval.

## Contributing

If you have suggestions for how autoapproval could be improved, or want to report a bug, open an issue! We'd love all and any contributions.

For more, check out the [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## License

[ISC](LICENSE) © 2018 [Dmytro Khmelenko](https://dkhmelenko.github.io/)

--- config ---
_extends: github-settings

from_owner: 
  - dependabot[bot]

required_labels: 
  - dependencies

blacklisted_labels:
  - wip

apply_labels:
  - merge

--- tsconfig ---
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "allowJs": false,
    "lib": ["es2015", "es2017"],
    "module": "commonjs",
    "moduleResolution": "node",
    "target": "es5",

    "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true,

    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true
  },
  "include": [
    "src/**/*"
  ],
  "compileOnSave": false
}
